name: eShram
description: National database registration for unorganised workers with accidental insurance cover and access to social security schemes.
benefit: eShram card with ₹2 lakh accidental insurance cover

conditions.label: Must be at least 16 years old
Must be at most 59 years old
Must work in the unorganised sector
Must not be an income tax payer
Aadhaar must be linked to an active mobile number
